_doc: 32x32 sprites drawn from shapes (scripts/core/sprites.gd). Ops: [ell, cx, cy, rx, ry, col], [rect, x, y, w, h, col], [poly, [[x,y]...], col], [px, x, y, col]. Later ops paint over earlier ones. Slots A/a/C come from looks (class colour, its dark, accent); looks[0] is the class, [1] and [2] its mastery skins.
